tafsir.explanation_english: 'Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim' means starting with the name of Allah, the Most Gracious (who gives mercy to all creation) and the Most Merciful (who gives special mercy to believers). It teaches us to begin all good deeds in Allah's name.
tafsir.explanation_arabic: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم: أي أبدأ بكل اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، والرحمن الذي وسعت رحمته كل شيء، والرحيم الذي وصلت رحمته إلى المؤمنين خاصة
tafsir.key_takeaway: Always begin important tasks with Allah's name

tafsir.explanation_english: This is the greatest verse in the Quran. It describes Allah's absolute sovereignty, His eternal life, His knowledge of everything, and His power over the heavens and earth. No one can intercede without His permission, and He never gets tired of preserving creation.
tafsir.explanation_arabic: أعظم آية في القرآن، تثبت توحيد الله وأسمائه الحسنى، وتبين أنه الحي القيوم الذي لا تأخذه سنة ولا نوم، وأنه يعلم كل شيء، وكرسيه وسع السموات والأرض
tafsir.key_takeaway: Allah alone is the Sustainer and Protector of all existence
virtues: Protects from shaytan when recited at night
One of the doors to Jannah
